title: A fresh HTTP-cached catalog hides newly published lecture PDFs in the reader

source.summary: Found during actual L014 post-publication reader verification; PDF publication itself is valid.

environment.device: Mac headless browser; emulated mobile viewport
environment.display_mode: 390px browser viewport; not a physical iPad

steps: Visit L013 before deployment to warm the public manifest HTTP cache.
After L014 deployment, open its reader link in the same browser.
Compare simultaneous default and no-cache manifest requests before expiry.
observed.expected: The newly published PDF opens without clearing personal notes or storage.
observed.actual: Default reused the old167-document/13-unit catalog with max-age=600 and missed L014; no-cache immediately returned the new168-document/14-unit catalog. SW is push-only and CacheStorage was empty. Direct public PDF remained available.

limitations: Direct reproduction used isolated Firefox158, not a physical iPad/Pencil. Raw responses, headers and screenshots remain private.

policy_decision.rationale: A time-limited reader failure with direct-PDF and natural-expiry alternatives: P2. Narrow maintenance during authorized publication; no other schedules or work priorities changed.
policy_decision.revisit_when: A new lecture or PDF edition fails to open with a warm HTTP cache.
